composition_variation: Create a soft cinematic anime portrait of adult Future Trunks waiting at a quiet rural train platform. Preserve his distinctive lavender center-parted hair, blue eyes, and thoughtful adult expression. Dress him in a plain cropped blue jacket, fully covering black shirt, gray trousers, and sturdy boots, with no equipment on his back. He stands at ease holding a small travel bag by its handle. Use dusty lilac mountains, honey sunset edges, pale concrete, and a spacious rose-to-blue sky gradient. Design for native 1024x1536 portrait format: important forms inside x158..866, faces inside x240..784. Leave the upper 28 percent quiet for the lock-screen clock. Use an original composition, no copied frames or promotional layout, text, logos, UI, weapons, fighting, extra characters, or distorted anatomy.
